svg.title: Predicate x*x > 40 over x = 0..41
svg.desc: False for x = 0..6, true for x = 7 and above (shown up to 10, then 20 and 41). The answer is 6, the first true is 7. Probes in order: 20 (T), 10 (T), 5 (F), 8 (T), 7 (T), 6 (F).
svg.text: isqrt(40): the largest x with x*x ≤ 40, searched over 0..41
